summary: Proof-worth entries for the bounded fixed or caller-followed recording producer with independently optional system-audio and microphone tracks.

entries.contract: One exact fixed display/window/region or caller-followed region binds canonical topology and source identity before one H.264 plus independently optional AAC-LC system-audio and microphone QuickTime producer acquires authority. The generic operation admission save atomically persists identity, bounds, zero progress, one of four exact selected-track summaries, and geometry generation 1. Fixed has no update authority. Caller-followed accepts full fresh topology/region/binding facts, validates live source continuity, containment, pixel bounds, cadence, deadline, and generation CAS, durably reserves at most one pending intent, and publishes the next generation only after one native crop succeeds. Invalid, stale, duplicate, off-source, and out-of-bounds updates have no native call, accepted mutation, or deadline reset; accepted-source containment loss, immutable discontinuity, and timeout stop with exact truth. Before publishing starting, the screen adapter installs a pending runtime owner that linearizes the public cancel/kill durable transaction against concrete runtime installation and start handoff. A stop in that interval terminal-cleans with authority absent and permanently denies the handoff; after handoff, the runtime admits the transaction under the same lock as follow installation, activation, and startup settlement. The first exact intent/outcome is immutable and same-action replayable, a different later action is rejected, failed durable admission has no native effect, and an admitted stop ends the timer and geometry before terminal-clean publication. Every durable geometry change advances one durable event sequence and emits exact geometry through the production operation-event sink and daemon envelope. Native failure and unresolved pending recovery preserve the last accepted generation and converge through cleanup. Video is mandatory, omission of optional tracks is exact video-only, and all six three-track first-sample orders open at one bounded common epoch only after every selected track arrives. A selected microphone consumes the existing exclusive voice_io_native_session declaration in the same claim-set as screen_capture_native_session and both consumers delegate tap lifecycle to one shared daemon AVAudioEngine owner. Each track preserves independent sample, backpressure, failure, drain, finalization, artifact, and custody truth; writer-global failure marks every selected track. One absolute startup deadline covers native start and the common-media barrier. Stop retires aggregate screen/microphone authority before claim release; success requires positive bytes for every selected finalized track plus a nonempty exact-media artifact; retain is typed unavailable; and durable release/remove recovery ends only in released, rolled back, or explicit residual truth.
entries.worth: This catches nil or request-mismatched selected-track truth; schema-invalid selection/projection; split startup budgets; three-track epoch divergence; callback-order-dependent terminal truth; zero-byte or zero-count first-sample truth; unbounded per-track backpressure; incomplete writer-global or simultaneous missing-track truth; wrong video/system-audio/microphone precedence; duplicate AVAudioEngine/tap ownership; microphone permission after file/writer effects; split or invented microphone resource claims; claim release before aggregate authority absence; macOS-15-only ScreenCaptureKit microphone use; post-stop sample admission; false artifact/media-identity success; custody drift; malformed admission; suppressed progress-save failures; help/schema drift; and native type errors without acquiring Screen Recording or Microphone permission or recording pixels or audio.
entries.guard: schema and static checks; deterministic compiled harnesses execute the production AOSOperationControlPlane cancel/kill path, registry/in-memory store/recovery/projector, screen adapter/runtime, parser, frame validator, geometry validator/coordinator, native-update and operation-event seams, lifecycle, three-track coordinator, terminal truth, custody, and shared microphone owner through injected topology/window/clock/native/media/file/broker dependencies; ten exact public stop cases cover cancel and kill after durable starting but before concrete runtime installation, before follow activation, while activation owns the runtime lock, immediately after timer arm, and in both first-writer races, with same-action replay, different-action rejection, failed-admission no-effect, exact durable outcome/geometry, and cleanup assertions. The two pre-install cases assert zero runtime start handoffs, broker acquisitions, native starts, and native stops; the eight post-install cases assert one native stop. All four fixed/followed selections, negative CAS/drift/deadline/native-failure/recovery cases, captured production operation-event and daemon envelopes, exact public schemas, and whole-source Swift compile only. ScreenCaptureKit, AVAssetWriter, AVAudioEngine, filesystem effects, daemon, raw repo build, native UI, TCC, pixels, audio, and media do not execute
